description: Event catalogue for Branch Cash Management journey. Introduces 1 event: EVT-166. Published by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core, CAP-001).

events.name: CashDepositAboveThreshold
events.trigger: Branch cash deposit received where amount exceeds £10,000 MLR 2017 Regulation 37 AML threshold.
events.journey_phase_name: Cash Deposit Receipt and AML Threshold Reporting

consumers.action: Queue AML cash threshold report for MLRO review; assess for suspicious activity patterns.
Write immutable AML threshold breach record.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.transactions.
events.worm_rationale: AML cash threshold report is an MLR 2017 regulatory record — immutable for FCA audit.
